Represents an email message with sender, recipients, subject, body, and optional attachments.

Remarks

This class serves as the abstraction for composing email messages across different mail providers. It supports HTML body content and optional attachments through the Parts property. Features not supported by every provider (Tags, ScheduledFor) are declared here so the application layer never depends on a provider specific package. Implementations that cannot honor them throw NotSupportedException rather than silently ignoring the request.

Gets or sets the optional date and time when the email should be delivered.

Remarks

When null, the email is sent immediately. Providers with no scheduling support throw NotSupportedException instead of delivering the message immediately.

string

Remarks

Used by email clients that cannot render HTML. Providers that generate it automatically from Body do so only when this property is not informed.
